name: Negative attention (Extraltodeus)
plain: Adds to attention scores a term from the difference between positive and negative attention. It uses a linear layer created on each call, so the projection is random and untrained.
math:
D = softmax(QKᵀ)V − softmax(QK_nᵀ)V
A = softmax(QKᵀ + Linear_new(D)·w); out = A·V
Linear_new is a new, randomly initialised nn.Linear each call.
label: from code
surprise: The projection is a freshly random nn.Linear on every attention call, so the effect depends on torch RNG state.

audit.note: Second term uses the negative value tensor, not V: D = softmax(QKᵀ)V − softmax(QK_nᵀ)V_n, where K_n,V_n are the second half of k,v (Extraltodeus__Negative-attention-for-ComfyUI-/nodes.py:26, 49-53). Patch is active only when k has more than 77 tokens (line 43); otherwise plain attention.
